celfmt -agent -i src.cel -o out1.cel
! stderr .

# Run celfmt again on the output to verify idempotency
celfmt -agent -i out1.cel -o out2.cel
! stderr .

# The two outputs should be identical
cmp out1.cel out2.cel

-- src.cel --
program: |-
  state.with(
    {
      "x": state.with(
        {
          "start_time": has(state.cursor) && has(state.cursor.last_timestamp) && state.cursor.last_timestamp != null ? state.cursor.last_timestamp : state.end_time,
        }
      ),
    }
  )
